task.title: Add PostgreSQL to docker-compose as system-wide persistent store

All artifacts implemented and verified. Please review: (1) docker-compose.yml postgres service config, (2) DATABASE_URL coverage on all dependent services, (3) .env.example completeness, (4) scripts/init-db.sh correctness.

Review failed: default init leaves pantheon DB owned by postgres, so pantheon_app cannot CREATE TABLE in schema public. Repro: POSTGRES_PORT=25432 docker compose -p infra-pg-review up -d postgres; docker exec -e PGPASSWORD=pantheon_app infra-pg-review-postgres-1 psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U pantheon_app -d pantheon -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c 'create table review_probe(id int);' -> ERROR: permission denied for schema public. Please update init-db.sh so the default app DB is owned by pantheon_app or grant the required schema ownership/create privileges, then hand back for review.

Schema public ownership fix applied (commit 4018762). Second psql block added to init-db.sh: ALTER SCHEMA public OWNER TO pantheon_app + GRANT ALL ON SCHEMA public. Repro command from review should now succeed. Ready for re-review.
Review approved: postgres healthcheck and DB wiring are intact, and live repro confirms the 4018762 schema ownership fix cleared the prior `permission denied for schema public` blocker.
